metadata.description: Lilystack, a quiet set of Claude Code skills and bash safety hooks, and three optional mods. No telemetry

plugins.name: lilystack
plugins.description: The best Claude Code skills from top GitHub repositories, in short rewrites: think, plan, build, check and ship, plus bash safety hooks. Markdown and bash; no telemetry

plugins.name: verify-gate
plugins.description: A mod: an APPROVED stamp above the prompt when the checks pass on the committed and pushed tree, and a stop on PR merges until then. Offline

plugins.name: outbound-ledger
plugins.description: A mod: a pane that records each outward action of the session (pushes, gh, web, MCP writes, artifacts). Read-only and offline

plugins.name: focus
plugins.description: A mod: one main action and the few tasks after it, in a pane where you check them off. Claude keeps it current and follows up. Offline
